title: NAS key set identifier information element

notes: Type of security context flag (TSC) (octet 1): Bit 4 - 0: native security context (for KSIAMF), 1: mapped security context (for KSIASME)
TSC does not apply for NAS key set identifier value '111'
NAS key set identifier (octet 1): Bits 3 2 1 - 0 0 0 through 1 1 0: possible values for the NAS key set identifier
1 1 1: no key is available (UE to network); reserved (network to UE)
